preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in a) and all(c in '01' for c in b)
preconditions.description: Both strings consist only of characters '0' and '1'.
The length of each string does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES\n' if ('1' in a and '1' in b) or ('1' not in a and '1' not in b) else 'NO\n'
postconditions.description: Output is 'YES' if both strings contain at least one '1' or both contain no '1's; otherwise output is 'NO'.
